en: Color postcard showing a medieval European old town with red-tile roofs and a prominent Gothic church featuring a tall central spire flanked by four smaller spires and clock faces. A curved red-brick ramparts-like walkway and cobblestone street with a small orange car are in the foreground. Clear blue sky; people strolling on the ramp. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and Bucharest postmark; printed caption indicates Sibiu.
